scope: Exact-product drop/pump conversion factors. This registry does not itself authorize a clinical regimen.

products.source: INFARMED pharmacovigilance bulletin / circular on Tramal oral drops administration
products.safety_note: One drop from the dropper contains 2.5 mg tramadol hydrochloride. Do not equate a pump actuation with one drop.

products.source: INFARMED pharmacovigilance communication on overdose risk with metered pump
products.safety_note: One full pump actuation contains 12.5 mg, equivalent in amount to five dropper drops. Display actuations separately from drops.
